parts.signature: const float PI, TAU, PHI, SQRT3
parts.contract: the constants every module uses, defined once (needs the composer to provide consts, architecture S1)

parts.signature: float dot2(vec2 v) / float dot2(vec3 v)
parts.contract: squared length, so distance formulas take one square root

parts.signature: float safeDiv(float n, float d, float eps)
parts.contract: n/d with abs(d) floored at eps and its sign kept; never Inf or NaN

parts.signature: vec3 safeNormalize(vec3 v, vec3 fallback) (+vec2)
parts.contract: v/length(v) when dot(v,v) > 1e-24, else fallback; required in any pass that writes a feedback buffer

parts.signature: float safeSqrt(float x)
parts.contract: sqrt(max(x,0)); rounding that pushes a value slightly negative gives 0, not NaN

parts.signature: float safeAcos(float x)
parts.contract: acos(clamp(x,-1,1)); unit dot products can exceed 1 by one ulp

parts.signature: float safePow(float b, float e)
parts.contract: pow on max(b, 1e-30); defined for all inputs

parts.signature: float safeLog2(float x, float floorVal)
parts.contract: log2(max(x, floorVal)); silence gives a finite floor, not -Inf

parts.signature: vec4 finiteOr(vec4 v, vec4 fallback)
parts.contract: replaces each non-finite component; the last guard before any feedback write, so one bad texel cannot poison a loop
parts.loved_text: Saturday, Oscillo Donut, Dry Ice (feedback shaders)

parts.signature: mat2 rotate2(float a)
parts.contract: exact counter-clockwise rotation; never the golfed constant-offset approximation
parts.loved_text: Glitch Transform, Geodesic, Sincos 3D, Blue Red Shiny, Starship (all rotate; three golf it)

parts.signature: mat3 rotateAxis(vec3 axis, float a)
parts.contract: Rodrigues axis-angle rotation; axis must be unit length

parts.signature: mat3 rotateOnto(vec3 from, vec3 to)
parts.contract: trig-free rotation taking one unit direction onto another; undefined for exactly opposite vectors (caller handles)

parts.signature: mat3 rotateEuler(vec3 rates, float t)
parts.contract: three-axis rotation at incommensurate rates (a tumble that never visibly repeats)

parts.signature: int imodFloor(int a, int b) (+ivec2)
parts.contract: floor modulo for b > 0: result in [0,b) for any sign of a (the % operator is undefined for negatives and differs on ANGLE)
parts.loved_text: Dry Ice (its +100 guard is the hand-made version)

parts.signature: int cellIndex(float x)
parts.contract: int(floor(x)); int() truncates toward zero, so int(-0.5) would wrongly be 0

parts.signature: int idivFloor(int a, int b)
parts.contract: floor(a/b) for any sign of a

parts.signature: float fmodFloor(float x, float m)
parts.contract: x - m·floor(x/m), pushed back into [0,m) when rounding lands exactly on m

parts.signature: float roundHalfUp(float x)
parts.contract: floor(x + 0.5); round() may round halves to even

parts.signature: int unrollBarrier(int n, int frame)
parts.contract: n + min(frame, 0): equals n at run time but the compiler cannot see it, so the loop stays a loop (compile time and code size of one body under ANGLE's Direct3D compiler)

parts.signature: float ulp32(float x) / float ulp16(float x)
parts.contract: the spacing of float32 or float16 at x; a diagnostic for coarse coordinates and rotting clocks

parts.signature: float clkPhase(float tWrapped, float hz)
parts.contract: fract(hz·t) in cycles for a host-wrapped t; the host keeps t small so the phase never rots

parts.signature: float clkPhaseSplit(float tWhole, float tFrac, float hz)
parts.contract: phase from whole seconds plus a fraction passed separately; error about ulp(hz) at any uptime

parts.signature: float clkKeep(float keepPerSecond, float dt)
parts.contract: pow(keepPerSecond, dt): a decay that looks the same at 60 Hz and 240 Hz
parts.loved_text: Dry Ice (clamp-then-damp), Oscillo Donut (phosphor 0.85), AURORA (state buffer)

parts.signature: float clkAlpha(float dt, float tau)
parts.contract: 1 - exp(-dt/tau): the blend weight of a one-pole smoother with time constant tau seconds

parts.signature: float clkStutter(float t, float period)
parts.contract: floor(t/period): a seed that holds still, then jumps (the stutter tempo of glitch art)
parts.loved_text: Glitch Transform (0.6 s), Hex Glitch (drifting 7, 9, 11, 12-frame dice)

parts.signature: float clkStall8(float keepPerFrame)
parts.contract: the level an 8-bit buffer stops decaying at under a per-frame multiply; a diagnostic

parts.signature: vec2 uvCentered(vec2 fragCoord, vec2 res)
parts.contract: origin at the canvas centre, y in [-1,1], x scaled by the same factor: aspect-true, y up

parts.signature: float uvPixel(vec2 res)
parts.contract: the size of one pixel in uvCentered units (2/res.y); exact for any unwarped domain

parts.signature: float uvFootprint(vec2 p)
parts.contract: pixel footprint of a continuous coordinate: the larger screen-derivative length. Never pass an id or a folded value (floor 6)

parts.signature: vec2 uvContain(vec2 uv, vec2 srcRes, vec2 dstRes, out float inside)
parts.contract: letterboxed "contain" mapping of a source image (video) into the canvas; inside is 0 in the bars
parts.loved_text: — (house: video_uv pasted in 6 presets and play.js)

parts.signature: vec2 uvSimilarity(vec2 p, vec2 centre, float zoom, float angle)
parts.contract: one similarity transform from screen to view space, so zoom and spin are one call

parts.signature: float shpLinstep(float a, float b, float x)
parts.contract: linear 0-to-1 ramp from a to b, clamped; the box-filter edge

parts.signature: float shpSmoother(float a, float b, float x)
parts.contract: quintic ramp: zero slope and curvature at both ends (C2)

parts.signature: float shpImpulse(float x, float k)
parts.contract: exponential impulse: 0 at x=0, exactly 1 at x=1/k, then decays

parts.signature: float shpPulse(float x, float centre, float halfWidth)
parts.contract: cubic bump, 1 at centre, exactly 0 beyond halfWidth

parts.signature: float shpGain(float x, float k)
parts.contract: S-curve (k>1) or inverse S (k<1) on [0,1] fixing 0, ½ and 1

parts.signature: float shpParabola(float x, float k)
parts.contract: bump 0→1→0 on [0,1] with sharpness k

parts.signature: float shpPowerCurve(float x, float a, float b)
parts.contract: asymmetric bump with peak normalised to 1

parts.signature: float shpAlmostIdentity(float x, float threshold, float floorValue)
parts.contract: equals x above threshold, smoothly floored below; C1

parts.signature: float shpSoftAbs(float x, float k)
parts.contract: creaseless abs: sqrt(x²+k); limits the high frequencies abs() creates in turbulence and mirrors
parts.loved_text: Starry Planes (smooth abs in the star)

parts.signature: float shpTri(float x)
parts.contract: triangle wave, period 1, range [0,1]
parts.loved_text: Plasma Globe, Satisfying, Chromatic Curtains, Rhodium

parts.signature: float shpRemap(float v, float a, float b, float c, float d)
parts.contract: unclamped linear refit of [a,b] onto [c,d]; the carving tool that erodes edges and keeps cores

parts.signature: float shpInvPower(float d, float r, float k)
parts.contract: (r/d)^k: a soft threshold with enormous gain. Valleys of mild noise become hot filaments; the same curve draws twinkling stars and glare (one primitive, four jobs)

parts.signature: float shpTentPow(float x, float centre, float width, float power)
parts.contract: a linear tent shaped by an exponent; animating the exponent makes a band breathe

parts.signature: float shpPadded(float a, float b, float pad, float x)
parts.contract: smoothstep with plateaus at both ends, so a key lands and holds

parts.signature: float shpBandPass(float m, float offset)
parts.contract: sin(π·m - offset), clamped: peaks mid-transition, so a mask draws rims, crusts and coastlines

parts.signature: uint hashU1(uint x)
parts.contract: PCG-style one-in-one-out hash, full avalanche on 32 bits

parts.signature: uvec3 pcg3d(uvec3 v)

parts.signature: uvec4 pcg4d(uvec4 v)
parts.contract: four-in-four-out for (x, y, z, seed) or (x, y, frame, seed)

parts.signature: uvec2 pcg2d(uvec2 v)

parts.signature: float u01(uint x) (+uvec2, uvec3, uvec4)

parts.signature: uvec3 cellU3(vec3 p) / uvec2 cellU2(vec2 p)
